description: Deep-dive ONE market before building or investing — the market is the semantic neighbourhood of your natural-language query (nearest providers by text embedding, NO fixed category). Every field is MEASURED: the observed-pricing benchmark separated by provider type and buyer tier (median, mean, stdev, p25/p75, min–max range and n via the canonical pricing engine), how many providers are in the neighbourhood and how many are priced, and the top providers already competing there with their observed price and relevance. Pass `query` (a natural-language capability or market, e.g. 'customer support chatbot'). For market + pricing + a ready shortlist in one call, use research_capability.

cohort_ref.description: Optional (1.17.0): reuse the exact set of comparable providers selected by an earlier price_benchmark / market_report / research_capability call (its cohort_ref), instead of re-selecting the market from new wording.

limit.description: full mode: members per page (1–150, default 50).

offset.description: full mode: paging offset over members (default 0).

query.description: Natural-language capability or market, e.g. 'customer support chatbot' or 'ai phishing detection'.

request_ref.description: Optional task reference (rq_ + 12 hex) from an earlier answer. Continues that task: its remembered facts (quantities, budget, requirements, benchmark selection) apply to this call, and the answer keeps the same request_ref.

response_mode.description: 'summary' (DEFAULT): neighbourhood counts, per-type/per-tier price cohorts and the top 12 providers. 'full' (1.17.0): EVERY member of the neighbourhood, paged with offset / limit, each with its price reading (plan, unit, currency, source, observed date).

name: market_report
